label: At a source with an invariant set-up, a power exercised in a withheld giving is rational
paraphrase: OPEN (DNP_inv, analyst formulation; WEAK version of DNP-prime): for every being y at w whose set-up is invariant at w (the same intrinsic states and external conditions at every accessible world where it exists: the surrogate of a simple, patientless source), if y gives x being at w by its power p and does not give x being at an accessible world where it exists, then p is rational. With excluded middle it is exactly the denial of CHANCE_3 at beings with an invariant set-up (controls, law 11): it restates the chance rival's denial at such sources and adds no discriminating information against that rival beyond its own warrant (note, section 5). Physical propensities are not counterexamples to it on the assumption that their bearers' set-ups differ at some accessible world.
